name: Low Tech Weapon Table
notes: Starting equipment: 3 rolls on the Military Weapon Table (for each crew member who rolled at least one Savvy increase, one of these may be taken on the High-tech Weapon Table instead), 3 rolls on the Low-tech Weapon Table, 1 roll on the Gear Table, 1 roll on the Gadget Table, and 1 credit per crew member. Items can be distributed as you see fit. All weapons are detailed on pages 50-52.
